panels.description: Per-server IP diversity. Columns: server (group label), phones (total devices on server), unique_ips (server-wide distinct IPs during window), device_unique_ips_sum (sum of each device's distinct IP count; matches device-table footer), attempts (rotation requests), succ_attempts (IP changed), failed_attempts (IP did not change), failed_pct.

targets.rawSql:
WITH proxies_labeled AS (
  SELECT
    device_id,
    CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(name)) REGEXP 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(name)), 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+'), 'S[0-9]{1,3}') WHEN UPPER(TRIM(name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]+[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS server
  FROM proxies
),
proxies_filtered AS (
  SELECT device_id, server
  FROM proxies_labeled
  WHERE ('${server:csv}' IN ('', '$__all') OR FIND_IN_SET(server, '${server:csv}') > 0)
),
phones_per_server AS (
  SELECT server, COUNT(*) AS phone_count
  FROM proxies_filtered
  GROUP BY server
),
rotations_in_window AS (
  SELECT pf.server, ir.proxy_id, ir.id, ir.ip_before, ir.ip_after, ir.success
  FROM ip_rotations ir USE INDEX (ip_rotations_rotation_timestamp_idx)
  JOIN rotation_cycles rc ON rc.id = ir.cycle_id AND rc.cycle_type <> 'inactive_proxy'
  JOIN proxies_filtered pf ON pf.device_id = ir.proxy_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ir.rotation_timestamp)
),
rotation_stats AS (
  SELECT
    server,
    COUNT(*) AS attempts,
    SUM(CASE WHEN success = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS succ_attempts,
    SUM(CASE WHEN success = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_attempts
  FROM rotations_in_window
  GROUP BY server
),
ips_in_window AS (
  SELECT server, proxy_id, ip_before AS ip FROM rotations_in_window WHERE ip_before IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT server, proxy_id, ip_after AS ip FROM rotations_in_window WHERE ip_after IS NOT NULL
),
unique_ips_per_server AS (
  SELECT server, COUNT(DISTINCT ip) AS unique_ips
  FROM ips_in_window
  GROUP BY server
),
unique_ips_per_device AS (
  SELECT server, proxy_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ip) AS unique_ips
  FROM ips_in_window
  GROUP BY server, proxy_id
),
device_unique_ips_per_server AS (
  SELECT server, SUM(unique_ips) AS device_unique_ips_sum
  FROM unique_ips_per_device
  GROUP BY server
)
SELECT
  rs.server,
  COALESCE(pps.phone_count, 0) AS phones,
  COALESCE(uips.unique_ips, 0) AS unique_ips,
  COALESCE(duips.device_unique_ips_sum, 0) AS device_unique_ips_sum,
  rs.attempts,
  rs.succ_attempts,
  rs.failed_attempts,
  ROUND(100.0 * rs.failed_attempts / NULLIF(rs.attempts, 0), 2) AS failed_pct
FROM rotation_stats rs
LEFT JOIN unique_ips_per_server uips ON uips.server = rs.server
LEFT JOIN device_unique_ips_per_server duips ON duips.server = rs.server
LEFT JOIN phones_per_server pps ON pps.server = rs.server
ORDER BY unique_ips ASC;

panels.title: Unique IPs per server

panels.description: Per-device IP diversity leaderboard. Sorted lowest unique_ips first. Columns: device_id, device label, server group, proxy_status, ws_status, unique_ips (distinct IPs held — before ∪ after), attempts, succ_attempts (IP changed), failed_attempts (IP did not change), failed_pct.

targets.rawSql:
WITH proxies_filtered AS (
  SELECT
    device_id,
    name,
    proxy_status,
    ws_status,
    CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(name)) REGEXP 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(name)), 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+'), 'S[0-9]{1,3}') WHEN UPPER(TRIM(name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]+[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS server
  FROM proxies
),
active_cycles AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM rotation_cycles
  WHERE $__timeFilter(cycle_timestamp)
    AND cycle_type <> 'inactive_proxy'
),
ips_in_window AS (
  SELECT proxy_id, ip_before AS ip FROM ip_rotations
  WHERE $__timeFilter(rotation_timestamp)
    AND ip_before IS NOT NULL
    AND cycle_id IN (SELECT id FROM active_cycles)
  UNION
  SELECT proxy_id, ip_after AS ip FROM ip_rotations
  WHERE $__timeFilter(rotation_timestamp)
    AND ip_after IS NOT NULL
    AND cycle_id IN (SELECT id FROM active_cycles)
),
unique_ips_per_device AS (
  SELECT proxy_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ip) AS uniq
  FROM ips_in_window
  GROUP BY proxy_id
)
SELECT
  p.device_id,
  p.name AS device,
  p.server,
  p.proxy_status,
  p.ws_status,
  COALESCE(MAX(uipd.uniq), 0) AS unique_ips,
  COUNT(ir.id) AS attempts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ir.success = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS succ_attempts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ir.success = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_attempts,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ir.success = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(ir.id), 0), 2) AS failed_pct
FROM ip_rotations ir
USE INDEX (ip_rotations_proxy_id_rotation_timestamp_idx)
JOIN proxies_filtered p ON p.device_id = ir.proxy_id
LEFT JOIN unique_ips_per_device uipd ON uipd.proxy_id = ir.proxy_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(ir.rotation_timestamp)
  AND ('${server:csv}' IN ('', '$__all') OR FIND_IN_SET(p.server, '${server:csv}') > 0)
  AND ('${device:csv}' IN ('', '$__all') OR FIND_IN_SET(ir.proxy_id, '${device:csv}') > 0)
  AND ir.cycle_id IN (SELECT id FROM active_cycles)
GROUP BY ir.proxy_id, p.device_id, p.name, p.server, p.proxy_status, p.ws_status
HAVING attempts >= 1
ORDER BY unique_ips ASC, failed_pct DESC

panels.description: Failed rotation % and total attempts over the selected time range. Solid line is failed %, secondary bars show attempts to contextualise low-N spikes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(ir.rotation_timestamp, $__interval) AS time,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN ir.success = FALSE THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    2
  ) AS "Failed %",
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN ir.success = TRUE THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    2
  ) AS "Success %",
  COUNT(*) AS "Attempts"
FROM ip_rotations ir USE INDEX (ip_rotations_rotation_timestamp_idx)
JOIN proxies p ON p.device_id = ir.proxy_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(ir.rotation_timestamp)
  AND ('${server:csv}' IN ('', '$__all') OR FIND_IN_SET(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+'), 'S[0-9]{1,3}') WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]+[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END, '${server:csv}') > 0)
  AND ('${device:csv}' IN ('', '$__all') OR FIND_IN_SET(ir.proxy_id, '${device:csv}') > 0)
  AND ir.cycle_id IN (
    SELECT id
    FROM rotation_cycles rc
    WHERE cycle_type <> 'inactive_proxy'
      AND $__timeFilter(rc.cycle_timestamp)
  )
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;
